opinions.title: ICAN GRA04 Build (NBD
opinions.configuration: Size M for a 179 cm rider, GRX 812, XM Carbon Speed wheels (28 mm front, 26 mm rear internal), 38 cm bar flaring to 45 cm.
opinions.summary: Chosen over an aero gravel frame because the owner rides a lot of rough singletrack, where the GRA04 suits them better. 2.1 in tires are the most they would run at the rear; the front could probably take 2.2 in.

opinions.title: Gravel CC frameset (comment)
opinions.configuration: GRA04 with ICAN seatpost, integrated bar and wheels; long-time ICAN customer.
opinions.summary: Rates it highly after eight Gravel World Series races with age-group podiums in six, and describes it as close to the Graro but with clearance for 50 mm tires.
